  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JULY 25, 2023

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Davis at 5:32 p.m., on
  Tuesday, July 25, 2023, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA and 2345 23rd
  Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Gleam Davis
  Mayor Pro Tem Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Phil Brock
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre (arrived at 5:33 p.m.)
  Councilmember Christine Parra (via telephone)
  Councilmember Caroline Torosis (arrived at 5:34 p.m.)
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:32 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers de la Torre and Torosis. City
  Attorney Douglas Sloan led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.
  Councilmember de la Torre
  arrived at 5:33 p.m.  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 6:09 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 7:40 p.m., with Councilmembers Brock, de
  Councilmember Torosis  la Torre, and Mayor Pro Tem Negrete absent, to report the following:
  arrived at 5:34 p.m.
  3.A. Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation –
  Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1): Scott Hobbs v. City of Santa
  Monica, et al.; LASC Case No. 21STCV14880 [report out only]

  The City Attorney reported Council approved Settlement Agreement No.
  11448 (CCS) in the amount of $145,000 paid by the city and $175,000 paid
  by the adjacent property owner at the June 27, 2023, meeting with 7-0
  vote.

  1  July 25, 2023
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 0ED62E9E-6192-4EBF-BCA0-B080E58B7BB3

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 7:42 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Gleam Davis
  City Clerk  Mayor

  2  July 25, 2023
